svg.title: AMD Ryzen Threadripper 7980X functional CPU schematic
svg.desc: Original non-scale functional block schematic for AMD Ryzen Threadripper 7980X: 64 cores, 128 threads, sTR5 package, Quad-channel DDR5-5200 ECC RDIMM and 48 native PCIe 5.0 lanes from the CPU; platform-level lane availability and bifurcation depend on TRX50 board wiring.

g.text: 48 native PCIe 5.0 lanes from the CPU; platform-level lane availability and bifurcation depend on TRX50 board wiring. • NOT A PINOUT • NOT TO SCALE
